cases.deviation: Lago's ClickHouse store collapses copies by (code, organization, subscription, transaction ID, timestamp) at query time (app/services/events/stores/clickhouse_store.rb:13) and counts two; its PostgreSQL store and API reject the second (db/structure.sql:12094, validate_creation_service.rb:43-50). Tanvo keeps one event per (organization, subscription, transaction ID) in every store.
